current_activity: laying footbridges over the Matanikau before the 5th Marines crossed
notes: Miller, ch. VIII: between 0100 and 0600 on 1 November, A, C and D Companies of the 1st Engineer Battalion laid three fuel-drum footbridges over the Matanikau after E Company, 5th Marines, outposted the west bank. A vehicular bridge was finished the same day about 500 yards from the mouth. Confidence 0.5: day-level, one official-history family (us_army_cmh).
